integrity: General proof reconstructed in RESULT.md and checked by exhaustive finite-poset maps and independent implication calculations; calculations cannot replace unbounded proof. Files are complete with SHA-256 and byte counts in the private envelope.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to finite direct powers of a single nontrivial Gödel chain; it counts idempotent endomorphisms by image isomorphism type and cardinality, not individually embedded retract subalgebras. The standard Heyting p-morphism duality is prior work. The complete text of the closest 2025 homomorphism-enumeration chapter was not accessible, leaving an antecedent risk.
title: Idempotent retraction spectra of powers of finite Gödel chains
